name: @volt/local-stack
description: Provisioning of a single-user local VOLT stack, shared by the desktop app (Node server and daemon processes) and the web client (the same backends in browser workers): the environment each backend starts with, the bootstrap that creates the local account, team and cluster, and the default plugin seed. Raw TypeScript source, no build step, no barrel; it runs in Node and in the browser, with persistence and logging supplied by the caller.
